about: A complete trophy guide and tracker for Grand Theft Auto VI on PlayStation 5. Trophy names, descriptions and grades are the official ones PlayStation publishes; every guide, roadmap stage and warning below was written for this app and cites the source each fact comes from.

roadmap.title: Story First: Lucia and Jason
roadmap.summary: Play the campaign from the opening mission, Gone Fishing, through the final mission before you chase anything else. The chapter trophies and the named-mission trophies all pop on the way, and finishing the story unlocks the whole state of Leonida for the cleanup stages. Six trophies in this stage are missable-risk: they hang on one-time story moments or choices (an unscheduled airport departure, a tank set-piece, a showroom escape, a cocktail in an early scene, and the choice-driven pair Actions Speak Louder and Bad Luck, I Guess). Read their warnings before you start, keep a manual save at the start of every chapter, and never overwrite your only save after a big choice.

roadmap.title: Loose Ends: Strangers and Strands
roadmap.summary: With the story done, work through the side-story strands scattered across Leonida. Finishing the last job for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone earns a trophy each, Bret needs one unique animal hunted, and completing any eight full strands earns Strangers & Freaks. Strands open up as the story progresses, so most of this stage is driving between markers you already unlocked in stage 1. None of these are missable: strand givers wait for you in free roam.

roadmap.title: See All of Leonida
roadmap.summary: Explore the whole map: Vice City and Vice Beach, the Leonida Keys, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, Mount Kalaga, the Grassrivers and Kelly County. Entering all 52 tracked areas earns The Goodtime State, and this is the natural stage to sample every one of the 9 activity types once for Master of None, because you will pass most of them while exploring. Keep your eyes open for something strange in the swamps and back roads: The Truth Is Out There rewards witnessing one of Leonida's weird random events, and those appear most often while you are roaming rather than fast-travelling.

roadmap.title: The Collectibles Sweep
roadmap.summary: Four checklist trophies, best done with the map already open from stage 3. Complete 3 Collectible Card sets for Don't Touch My Deck, WAiNK It at 100 locations, meditate at all 18 spots for Positive Mental Attitude, and discover 100 different vehicles for Whip It Good. Work region by region so nothing is left stranded, and use the tracker's search to tick each family off as you go. Vehicle discoveries come fastest in varied traffic: ports, airports, rich districts and rural roads all spawn different pools.

roadmap.title: Skill Trials
roadmap.summary: The grind stage. Gold-medal all 42 Shooting Range challenges for The Shootist, push your stunt count to 250 for Cunning Stunts, win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations, win 20 different races, beat Cal in a fishing challenge, finish one arcade game, and land the two combat feats: five takedowns in a single Combat Focus (Gunslinger) and a melee drive-by knockdown (Ten Pin). The shooting range is the long pole of the whole platinum: practise a weapon family at a time and learn each challenge's target pattern instead of chasing golds at random.

roadmap.title: Crime, Cash and the Last Percent
roadmap.summary: Free-roam crime and money, plus the completion capstone. Rob 5 bank vaults and escape, rob an armored truck, rob a jewelry store unseen, and rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts and spend $100,000 across all shops, buy all 8 garage properties, register 10 vehicles on the Scooter Bros app, bowl at the Kolt & Associates alley, and finish 50 challenges. When everything else on the checklist is done, the same work carries you to 100% completion and A Long Road.

roadmap.title: Partner Up, Then the Platinum
roadmap.summary: Three trophies need your partner in crime with you: lose a 4-star wanted level together and escape (Hot Together), rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level (Retail Therapy), and the partnership moment behind Personal Best. Do these last, when both characters are geared up and you know the map's escape routes by heart. The moment the final requirement falls, Vice Got a Price! unlocks and the platinum is yours.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum, awarded automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. There is nothing to do for this one directly: work the roadmap from stage 1 to stage 7, keep an eye on the six missable-risk trophies flagged in this guide during the story, and let the tracker count you down. If it does not pop, one trophy is still outstanding - filter the tracker to unearned and the missing one will be the only row left.
steps: Earn every other trophy in the list (54 of 54).
Follow the roadmap stages in order so the missable-risk story trophies are handled during stage 1.
When the last requirement falls, this trophy unlocks on its own.
tips: Use the tracker's per-tier counters to confirm you are at 1 platinum pending, 2 gold, 6 silver and 46 bronze before the final push.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: A story trophy for finishing Gone Fishing, the opening mission of the campaign. Start a new game and play the prologue through to its end: it introduces Lucia fresh out of prison and the basics of moving, driving and shooting in Leonida. The trophy pops on the mission-complete screen, before the open world fully opens up. It cannot be missed, because the story cannot advance without it.
steps: Start a new game and begin the opening mission, Gone Fishing.
Follow the on-screen prompts through the prologue's driving and on-foot sections.
Finish the mission; the trophy pops on the completion screen.
tips: Take the prologue slowly: it doubles as the tutorial for systems the later skill trophies rely on, like Combat Focus.
sources: Rockstar Games - Grand Theft Auto VI Trailer 2 (2025)

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Awarded for completing Chapter 1 of the story. Simply keep following the main mission markers: the chapter closes after its final story beat, and the trophy pops as Chapter 2 begins. Chapter trophies are a straight line - no side content, collectible or choice is required, and none of them can be missed on a normal playthrough.
steps: Play the main story missions in order after Gone Fishing.
Finish the last mission of Chapter 1.
The trophy pops as the chapter ends.
tips: Make a manual save at the chapter break; it is your safety net for the missable-risk moments in later chapters.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Awarded for completing Chapter 2 of the story. The name is printed with asterisks on PlayStation itself, so do not go looking for a cleaner version of it in your trophy cabinet - this spelling is the official one. Keep pushing the main missions; the trophy pops at the chapter's final cutscene. Like every chapter trophy it is unmissable.
steps: Continue the main story from Chapter 1.
Finish the last mission of Chapter 2.
The trophy pops as the chapter ends.
tips: Chapter 2 is where the second protagonist's free-roam unlocks properly; side strands start appearing, but leave them for roadmap stage 2.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Awarded for completing Chapter 3 of the story, the chapter that opens Vice City up in earnest - its beaches, downtown and neon districts become your playground from here. Play the main missions in order and the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Unmissable, like all chapter trophies.
steps: Continue the main story from Chapter 2.
Finish the last mission of Chapter 3.
The trophy pops as the chapter ends.
tips: While the story takes you across Vice City, note the shooting ranges, race starts and shops you pass; stage 5 and 6 of the roadmap send you back to all of them.
sources: Rockstar Games - official GTA VI website, Leonida locations

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Awarded for completing Chapter 4 of the story, the last full chapter before the endgame. By now every district of Leonida should be reachable and most systems unlocked. Finish the chapter's final mission and the trophy pops; only the finale stands between you and the gold story trophy after this. Unmissable.
steps: Continue the main story from Chapter 3.
Finish the last mission of Chapter 4.
The trophy pops as the chapter ends.
tips: Before starting the final mission chain, double-check the missable-risk warnings for Actions Speak Louder and Bad Luck, I Guess - the endgame is where choices bite.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The gold story trophy, awarded for completing the final mission of the campaign and rolling the credits. It is the natural end of roadmap stage 1: chapters 1 to 4, the named missions, then the finale. Stock up on ammo, armor and snacks before the point-of-no-return prompt, and keep a separate manual save from before the finale so the endgame choices flagged elsewhere in this guide can never lock you out of anything.
steps: Complete Chapters 1 to 4 and all required story missions.
Start the final mission when prompted, after stocking up.
Finish the mission and watch the credits; the trophy pops at completion.
tips: The story continues in free roam after the credits, so nothing in the later roadmap stages is locked away by finishing.
sources: Rockstar Games - Grand Theft Auto VI Trailer 2 (2025)

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: A story trophy for completing the mission Breakfast Run, one of the named missions on the campaign's critical path. It appears as a main marker during the early chapters; play it when it surfaces and the trophy pops on the mission-complete screen. Named-mission trophies like this one are all unmissable - the story cannot be finished without them.
steps: Play the story until the Breakfast Run marker appears.
Complete the mission's objectives.
The trophy pops on the completion screen.
tips: If a named mission feels hard, dying and restarting a checkpoint is free - no trophy in the story set punishes retries.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: A story trophy for completing The Cartel Heist, the campaign's big set-piece robbery. Heists in this story play out in stages - preparation, the job itself and the getaway - and the trophy pops only when the whole mission, escape included, is complete. It is on the critical path and cannot be missed. Treat it as practice for the free-roam robbery trophies in roadmap stage 6: the vault routine here is the same one the bank robberies reuse.
steps: Play the story until The Cartel Heist unlocks.
Complete the preparation objectives and then the heist itself.
Escape the wanted level to finish the mission; the trophy pops on completion.
tips: Learn the getaway route the game suggests rather than improvising; the wanted level is scripted to be lost along it.
sources: Rockstar Games - Grand Theft Auto VI Trailer 2 (2025)

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: A story trophy for completing the mission Child's Play. It arrives as a main-story marker mid-campaign; play it through and the trophy pops on the completion screen. Unmissable, like every named-mission trophy in the set.
steps: Play the story until the Child's Play marker appears.
Complete the mission's objectives.
The trophy pops on the completion screen.
tips: Missions with family at the centre tend to be dialogue-heavy; do not skip the cutscenes if you are following the plot, because later choices reference them.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: A story trophy for completing the mission Headliners. Play it when its marker appears on the main path and finish every objective; the trophy pops on the completion screen. Unmissable.
steps: Play the story until the Headliners marker appears.
Complete the mission's objectives.
The trophy pops on the completion screen.
tips: Headliners puts you in front of crowds and cameras; keep moving during its open sections instead of trading shots from one spot.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: A story trophy for completing VCIA Takedown, the mission set at Vice City International Airport. VCIA matters beyond this mission: the missable-risk trophy Catch Me If You Can also hangs on an airport moment, so while the story has you here, check that trophy's warning before you leave the area. Finish the takedown's objectives and escape as directed; the trophy pops on completion. Unmissable.
steps: Play the story until the VCIA Takedown marker appears.
Complete the airport objectives and the escape.
The trophy pops on the completion screen.
tips: Airports mean open ground and long sightlines; a scoped rifle earns its keep here.
sources: Rockstar Games - official GTA VI website, Leonida locations

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: A story trophy for completing Operation Savage Glory, one of the campaign's late named missions. It unlocks on the main path after the earlier named missions are done. Play it through to the completion screen for the trophy. Unmissable.
steps: Play the story until the Operation Savage Glory marker appears.
Complete the mission's objectives.
The trophy pops on the completion screen.
tips: Late-story missions assume you have upgraded weapons and a stocked inventory; swing by a gun shop first if you have been skipping them.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The gold completion trophy: raise the game's completion stat to 100%. The percentage is fed by the story, the stranger strands, collectibles, activities, challenges and property ownership - in other words, almost everything else in this guide. Do not chase it directly; work the roadmap and use the in-game completion screen to find what is left. In practice the last few percent are always a handful of collectibles, one activity type never sampled, or a strand left unfinished, and the tracker filters make those easy to spot.
steps: Finish the story and all stranger strands (roadmap stages 1-2).
Complete the collectible families, activities and challenges from stages 3-5.
Buy the properties and finish the money milestones in stage 6.
Open the in-game completion screen, hunt down whatever still shows incomplete, and the trophy pops at 100%.
tips: Check the completion screen early, not just at the end: knowing exactly what counts saves hours of guessing later.
Exploration of all 52 areas (The Goodtime State) feeds this stat, so stage 3 pulls double duty.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts, as PlayStation counts them: stunt jumps and vehicle feats across Leonida, each landing registered once it is cleanly completed. The map is built for this - ramps on the causeways to the Keys, construction sites in Downtown Vice City, drainage canals, airport cargo yards and the Mount Kalaga foothills all hide stunt spots. Work them region by region alongside the collectibles sweep so travel time is shared, and use a fast, durable car or a dirt bike for anything involving a rough landing.
steps: Find a stunt spot (ramps, jumps and marked stunt locations across the map).
Hit it with enough speed and land the vehicle upright on its wheels beyond the landing zone.
Repeat at new spots until the counter reaches 250; the trophy pops on the 250th completed stunt.
tips: A stunt that ends in a crash or a roof landing does not count; ease off the throttle mid-air to level the car out.
Motorcycles register airtime stunts more forgivingly than cars on short ramps.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list - Exophase (tracked count: 250 stunts)
Rockstar Games - official GTA VI website, Leonida locations

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the game's 9 activity types at least once. You do not need to win or even finish most of them - starting each type once is enough. The activity families are the ones the rest of this guide keeps meeting: races, drone races, the shooting range, fishing, arcade games, meditation spots, hunting, stunt spots and the gambling or leisure games Leonida offers. Roadmap stage 3 is built for this trophy: sample each icon type as exploration carries you past it, and the trophy pops when the ninth type has been tried.
steps: Open the map and note the different activity icon families.
Start one activity of each type (finishing is only needed where the activity has no clean exit).
When all 9 types have been tried once, the trophy pops.
tips: Keep a note of which types you have tried; the tracker cannot see inside the game, so tick them off here as you go.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list - PSNProfiles (9 activity types)

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges - the single longest skill grind on the list. Each challenge fixes a weapon family and a target pattern, and gold is a score threshold, not a win against anyone. Learn one family at a time: pistols reward speed, rifles reward streaks, and the moving-target challenges reward leading your shots. Accuracy multipliers matter more than raw pace, so a calm run with no misses usually out-scores a frantic one. If a challenge will not gold, come back with a better-tuned weapon and fresh eyes rather than grinding it tilted.
steps: Visit a Shooting Range and open its challenge list (42 challenges across the weapon families).
Play each challenge once to learn its target pattern, then replay for score.
Reach the gold-medal threshold on every challenge; the trophy pops on the 42nd gold.
tips: Never reload mid-string if the challenge allows a bigger magazine mod; downtime kills streak bonuses.
The range also quietly trains the aim you need for Gunslinger's five takedowns in one Combat Focus.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list - Exophase (tracked count: 42 Shooting Range challenges)

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. Unlike Master of None, sampling is not enough here - you must actually win at each course. Drone races are checkpoint sprints: the winning line is the one that cuts gates close without clipping them, because a missed gate costs more time than a cautious corner. Run each course once to learn it, then race it properly. Coastal courses around the Keys and Vice Beach have wind-blown straights; the Downtown course is a tight rooftop weave.
steps: Find a Top Fun drone race start point (14 across Leonida).
Learn the course with a practice run, noting tight gates.
Win the race, then repeat at every other location; the trophy pops on the 14th win.
tips: Stay low: gates are placed for a low racing line, and climbing costs speed.
If you miss a gate, restart immediately - backtracking almost never recovers the win.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list - PSNProfiles (14 Top Fun locations)

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races - different is the operative word, so winning the same street race 20 times does nothing. Leonida's race calendar spans street races in Vice City, off-road runs in Kelly County and the Grassrivers, and water-adjacent sprints around the Keys. Bring a vehicle matched to the class: a tuned sports car for asphalt, something with clearance for dirt. Twenty distinct wins is most of the calendar, so work through the map icons systematically and tick each win off in the tracker.
steps: Enter a race from its map marker with a suitable vehicle.
Win it; a win only counts once per distinct race.
Repeat across the map until 20 different races are won.
tips: Races you have already won are the trap - if the counter stops moving, you are repeating yourself; pick a fresh marker.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list - Exophase (tracked count: 20 races)

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal Hampton - Jason's friend, the one who would rather be on the water than anywhere near work - issues fishing challenges once fishing is unlocked, and his score is the bar to clear. Fishing challenges are scored on the catch, so work the good water: piers at Port Gellhorn, the Keys' shallows and the Grassrivers all hold bigger fish than the city canals. Learn the reeling rhythm first on free fishing, then take his challenge when you can land fish without snapping the line.
steps: Unlock fishing and meet Cal's challenge prompt.
Practise free fishing until you can land fish reliably.
Accept the challenge and out-score Cal before the timer ends.
tips: Ease the drag when a big fish runs; most lost challenges are snapped lines, not small catches.
sources: Rockstar Games - Grand Theft Auto VI Trailer 2 (2025), Cal Hampton

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game, start to finish. Leonida's bars, diners and boardwalk arcades carry playable cabinets; walk up to one, start a credit, and play it to its end screen rather than quitting out - completion is what counts, not a high score. Pick the shortest cabinet you can find if you just want the trophy, but most of them are charming enough to finish honestly. This also ticks the arcade family off Master of None's list.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet in a bar, diner or boardwalk arcade.
Start a game and play it through to its end screen.
The trophy pops when the game completes.
tips: Quitting mid-game does not count; even a lost run counts as long as the game itself reaches its end.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Andy's stranger strand. Strands are chains: each job you finish for Andy unlocks the next marker from him, and the trophy pops when the chain's last mission is done. Strand markers appear as you roam and as the story progresses, and they never expire - if Andy's next job has not appeared yet, advance the story or finish his current one and give the map a day of in-game time. This is one of the eight strands counted by Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Find Andy's first marker and complete his opening job.
Keep returning as each follow-up marker appears.
Complete his final mission; the trophy pops on completion.
tips: Strand progress feeds the 100% completion stat, so stage 2 is never wasted time.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Kenton's stranger strand. The name is a Jaws joke, and the strand lives up to it: Kenton's work is water-adjacent, so expect boats and the Keys. Work his chain of markers to the end and the trophy pops on the final mission's completion screen. Counts toward the eight strands needed for Strangers & Freaks, and cannot be missed - Kenton waits in free roam like every strand giver.
steps: Find Kenton's first marker and complete his opening job.
Follow the chain as new markers appear.
Complete his final mission; the trophy pops on completion.
tips: Keep a fast boat bought or borrowed nearby once Kenton's chain starts; several of his jobs begin on the water.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Billy's stranger strand. Billy's chain is a solo operator's storyline, played out across markers that appear as you explore and as the story advances. Finish the chain's last mission for the trophy. Like all strand trophies it is unmissable and counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Find Billy's first marker and complete his opening job.
Follow the chain as new markers appear.
Complete his final mission; the trophy pops on completion.
tips: If a strand marker seems to vanish, it usually means the next step is time-gated; sleep or advance a day and check the map again.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida. A strand is only complete when its final mission is done - the individual strand trophies in this list (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are five of the eight, and the rest belong to givers whose chains carry no trophy of their own, Bret's hunting work among them. The roadmap's stage 2 is built around this trophy: sweep the map for strand markers after the story, finish every chain you start, and the silver pops on the eighth completed strand.
steps: Accept a stranger's first job from their map marker.
Finish the whole chain, through its final mission - that is one strand.
Repeat until 8 strands are complete; the trophy pops on the eighth.
tips: Half-finished strands are the usual reason this trophy lags: if your count stalls, look for a chain you started and never closed out.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list - Exophase (tracked count: 8 strands)

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Randy's stranger strand. Randy's chain is about moving product around Leonida, so expect driving jobs and timed legs; bring a reliable vehicle. Finish the last mission of the chain for the trophy. Unmissable, and one of the eight strands counted by Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Find Randy's first marker and complete his opening job.
Follow the chain as new markers appear.
Complete his final mission; the trophy pops on completion.
tips: Delivery-style strand jobs punish vehicle damage; a slightly slower clean run beats a fast wrecked one.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Tyrone's stranger strand. Work his marker chain from the first job to the last; the trophy pops when the strand's final mission is complete. Unmissable, and one of the eight strands counted by Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Find Tyrone's first marker and complete his opening job.
Follow the chain as new markers appear.
Complete his final mission; the trophy pops on completion.
tips: Strand givers sometimes phone you before a marker appears; answer unknown calls during stage 2 rather than letting them ring out.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. The spots sit in the state's quiet corners - Mount Kalaga lookouts, Keys shorelines, Grassrivers clearings, rooftop gardens in Vice City. Walk onto a spot, use the prompt, and stay for the full meditation; leaving early does not register it. Because the spots are scattered exactly where stage 3's exploration takes you, mark each one off in the tracker as you find it and sweep whatever is left region by region in stage 4.
steps: Find a meditation spot (marked once discovered, in scenic locations statewide).
Use the prompt and complete the full meditation.
Repeat at all 18 spots; the trophy pops on the last one.
tips: Sunrise and sunset spots are easy to miss on a night-time sweep; if one region shows nothing, revisit it in daylight.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list - PSNProfiles (tracked count: 18 meditation spots)
Rockstar Games - official GTA VI website, Leonida locations

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret sends you after. Bret's strand is the hunting thread of the game: he marks a one-of-a-kind animal - the kind of creature the Grassrivers and Mount Kalaga backcountry hide - and your job is to track and take it. Follow his marker, work the trail, and make the kill clean when the animal shows itself. The trophy pops when the hunt is handed in. Bret's chain also counts toward the eight strands for Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Start Bret's strand from his marker and accept the hunt.
Track the unique animal through its territory, using the trail prompts.
Take the animal and return to Bret; the trophy pops on hand-in.
tips: Approach downwind and crouched for the final stretch; a spooked unique animal can take a long in-game while to reappear.
sources: Rockstar Games - official GTA VI website, Mount Kalaga and the Grassrivers

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida - on casino tables, bar counters, motel balconies, lifeguard stands and shop shelves - and they group into themed sets, so a set is only done when every card in it is found. Three complete sets is a serious sweep but far from every card in the game: pick the three sets whose cards cluster in regions you have already opened up, and work them card by card with the tracker open. Cards glint in the light; a slow walk through an interior finds more than a run.
steps: Pick up any Collectible Card to start tracking its set.
Find every remaining card of that set (sets complete one at a time).
Finish two more sets; the trophy pops when the third set completes.
tips: Interiors reset when you leave the area, but collected cards stay collected - never re-check a card you already hold.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list - PSNProfiles (tracked count: 3 card sets)

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It spot at 100 different locations. WAiNK spots are one of Leonida's recurring interactive markers - the same family of quick stop-and-interact points that the map scatters through every district. One hundred sounds like a lot, but the spots are dense in Vice City and appear in every town and rest stop on the map; the real task is coverage, not difficulty. Fold them into every other stage: whenever one is nearby, stop and use it, and tick the family off region by region in stage 4 if any are left.
steps: Find a WAiNK It location marker anywhere in Leonida.
Interact with it fully so the location registers.
Repeat at 100 different locations; the trophy pops on the 100th.
tips: Re-using the same location does not advance the counter; the tracker is your friend for remembering which districts are still thin.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list - Exophase (tracked count: 100 locations)

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's Challenges - the rotating task list that sits alongside the trophies (things like distances driven, near misses strung together, fish caught, shops visited). Challenges complete themselves as you play the roadmap: driving, racing, robbing and exploring all feed different ones. Check the challenge list whenever you are near the low forties and deliberately close out the cheapest remaining ones - short, specific tasks you can finish in minutes - rather than waiting for the fiftieth to happen by accident.
steps: Open the Challenges list in the pause menu to see what is being tracked.
Play normally through the roadmap; most challenges complete in the background.
When close, target the cheapest open challenges directly until 50 are complete.
tips: Challenges also feed the 100% completion stat, so this trophy and A Long Road rise together.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list - PSNProfiles (tracked count: 50 challenges)

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, and escape the heat together. The partnership is the point: both protagonists must be together when the stars clear. The reliable way is deliberate - raise exactly four stars somewhere with a planned escape (the causeways, a boat at a marina, or the drainage canals), then break line of sight and stay hidden until the search gives up. Doing it during stage 7, with the map memorised, turns a fiddly trophy into a five-minute job.
steps: Be together with your partner (both protagonists in the same session/vehicle).
Commit crimes until the wanted level reaches exactly 4 stars.
Break police line of sight and stay out of the search cones until the wanted level fully clears.
tips: Overshooting to 5 stars makes the search much longer; if you hit 5, let it decay to 4 before starting your escape.
Water is the cleanest escape: a boat beyond the search area ends most pursuits.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, keeping your wanted level alive the whole time. The chain breaks if the stars fully clear between shops, so pick a tight triangle of shops - a Vice Beach strip or a Stockyard block - and drive straight from till to till. Your partner must be with you for the robberies to count. Rob each till, move immediately, and only shake the heat after the third shop is done.
steps: Group up with your partner and pick three shops close together.
Rob the first shop and keep the wanted level active as you drive to the second.
Rob the second and third without the wanted level ever fully clearing; the trophy pops after the third.
tips: If the stars start flashing (about to clear) between shops, commit a quick visible crime - a smashed window or a shot in the air - to refresh them.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles - a vehicle is discovered the first time you get in and drive it. Leonida's traffic pools are regional: supercars in Vice Beach and Downtown, work trucks in Stockyard and Port Gellhorn, beaters and swamp rigs in Kelly County and the Grassrivers, boats and planes around the Keys and VCIA. The fastest route to 100 is variety, not distance: whenever a model you have not driven passes, swap into it. Parking lots, marinas and the airport are discovery goldmines because they pool rare spawns in one place.
steps: Enter and drive any vehicle you have not driven before; it registers as discovered.
Rotate regions to change the traffic pool (city, port, rural, Keys).
Keep swapping into new models until 100 are discovered.
tips: On the Spot (registering vehicles to the Scooter Bros app) overlaps heavily with this; do the two together in stage 6.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list - Exophase (tracked count: 100 vehicles)

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies inside a single activation of Combat Focus, the slow-motion aiming state. The trick is the setup, not the shooting: you need five enemies alive and in view at once, which story shootouts and gang operations provide naturally. Wait for a clustered group, trigger Combat Focus, and work left to right with a high-capacity weapon, prioritising anyone already aiming at you. If a run ends at four, do not force it - the next big shootout is always coming, and stage 6's gang operations are full of five-man groups.
steps: Find a fight with at least 5 enemies grouped in the open.
Let them settle into firing positions, then activate Combat Focus.
Take down all 5 before the Focus meter runs out.
tips: Headshots end targets instantly and save the meter for the next man.
A full-auto weapon with an extended magazine removes reload risk mid-Focus.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missableNote: MISSABLE RISK: the unscheduled departure is tied to the story's VCIA sequence. If you play through the airport section the intended way and leave on schedule, the moment passes. Keep a manual save before the VCIA Takedown mission, and if the trophy has not popped by the time the mission ends, reload and look for the off-script way out before finishing.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA - Vice City International Airport. In plain terms: during the airport sequence, leave in a way the plan never called for, taking a plane out off-script instead of following the scheduled route. The opportunity lives inside the story's VCIA section, which is why this guide flags it as missable-risk. When the airport opens up, look for a boardable aircraft away from the objective marker, get in, and take off. The trophy pops as your unscheduled flight leaves VCIA airspace.
steps: Save manually before starting the VCIA Takedown story mission.
During the airport sequence, break from the objective and find a boardable plane on the apron.
Take off from VCIA in it; the trophy pops as you depart.
tips: If the mission completes without the trophy, reload the pre-mission save immediately - post-story, the scripted apron setup is gone.
sources: Rockstar Games - official GTA VI website, Leonida locations

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.missableNote: MISSABLE RISK: Rhinos (the game's tanks) appear in a scripted story set-piece rather than roaming the map. Deal with the tanks during that sequence; if the mission ends with the encounter unresolved, reload your chapter save and replay it before moving on.
trophies.guide: The official description only jokes - 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' - but the meaning is plain: deal with Rhino tanks when the story throws them at you. Rhinos are the military's armoured answer during the campaign's biggest escalation, and the trophy is earned inside that set-piece, by surviving and neutralising the armour as the mission intends (explosives, heavy weapons, or stealing the fight to ground a tank cannot follow). Because free-roam Rhinos are not a normal spawn, this guide flags the trophy as missable-risk: finish the encounter properly when it comes.
steps: Play the story until the Rhino set-piece begins.
Use explosives or heavy weapons against the tanks' weaker rear and tracks, or follow the mission's own countermeasure prompts.
Clear the encounter and finish the mission; the trophy pops on completion.
tips: Never fight a Rhino head-on in the open; buildings and underpasses break its line of fire while you reposition.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected - a stealth robbery, start to finish. Scope the store first: cameras, the clerk's sightline and any guard patrol decide your route. Go in quiet, keep the clerk covered or subdued before an alarm can be raised, empty the cases, and leave without a wanted level ever appearing. If anyone spots you mid-job, walk away and try another store rather than forcing it - detection voids only the attempt, not the trophy, and jewelry stores restock for another try.
steps: Pick a jewelry store and watch its camera and staff pattern from outside.
Enter quietly, control the clerk before they can trigger an alarm, and avoid every camera cone.
Empty the cases and walk out with no detection and no wanted level; the trophy pops on the clean getaway.
tips: Night attempts have thinner staff; a silenced weapon is insurance, but firing it usually ends the stealth anyway - treat it as a last resort.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. A vault robbery is the full routine The Cartel Heist taught you: case the bank, get to the vault, crack it, take the money and lose the wanted level - a robbery where you are caught or killed on the way out does not count. Five different successful vault jobs is the target, so rotate banks around Vice City and Port Gellhorn. Upgrade your getaway driving and learn two or three reliable heat-shedding routes (canals, causeways, a boat swap) and the five escapes become routine.
steps: Enter a bank and reach its vault (follow the robbery prompts).
Crack the vault, take the money, and escape by fully losing the wanted level.
Repeat at banks until 5 vault robberies have ended in a clean escape.
tips: Park the getaway car facing out, doors open, before you go in; seconds saved at the kerb are worth more than a faster car.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list - PSNProfiles (tracked count: 5 bank vaults)

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run cash routes between banks and businesses; you will spot them by their boxy profile and livery. The doors will not open for small arms - the classic play, as the name says, is the GTA way: block the truck, use explosives or heavy fire on the rear doors, grab the cash bags, and go. The escape is part of the trophy: the robbery only counts once you have fully lost the wanted level it raises.
steps: Find an armored truck on its route and block it with your vehicle.
Blast or force the rear doors, grab the cash, and get moving immediately.
Lose the wanted level completely; the trophy pops on the clean escape.
tips: Hit the truck near a good escape corridor - a canal entrance or causeway - not in the middle of Downtown's grid.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 tracked areas of Leonida, Florida's most wanted state - the game's own nickname for it is right there in the trophy name. An area registers when you physically enter it, not when you see it on the map. The regions break down as Vice City's districts and Vice Beach, the Leonida Keys chain, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, Mount Kalaga's parkland, the Grassrivers, Stockyard and Kelly County's back roads. Fly or boat the coastline once to catch the islands, then sweep the interior; the last two or three areas are always small islands or a mountain pocket, so check the map's fog for unvisited slivers.
steps: Open the map and note which regions are still fogged or unvisited.
Travel through each of the 52 areas on foot, by vehicle, boat or air until it registers.
The trophy pops when the final area is entered.
tips: A helicopter is the fastest area-sweeper in the game; keep one for the endgame mop-up of missed pockets.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list - PSNProfiles (tracked count: 52 areas)
Rockstar Games - official GTA VI website, Leonida locations

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of Leonida's 9 gangs - one robbery per gang, not nine robberies anywhere. Gang operations sit in each gang's territory: stash houses, chop shops and cash businesses marked once discovered. The robbery counts when you take the operation's money and get clear. Because the gangs hold different districts, this trophy doubles as a tour of the state's criminal map; work it alongside Maximum Withdrawal in stage 6 and use the tracker to note which gangs are still unhit.
steps: Discover a gang's illegal operation in its territory.
Rob it - clear the defenders, take the cash, and escape.
Repeat until all 9 gangs have had an operation robbed.
tips: Gang operations also make a reliable five-enemy setup for Gunslinger if that trophy is still open.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list - Exophase (tracked count: 9 gangs)

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.missableNote: MISSABLE RISK: the name ('In The Beginning…') and the Ocean Beach setting tie this to an early story scene rather than a free-roam bar. If you rush the opening chapters' beach sequence, the moment can pass. Slow down during the early Ocean Beach scenes, take the drink when the scene offers it, and keep a chapter-start save until it pops.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The trophy's own name frames it as a beginning-of-the-story moment - the calm, postcard Vice City scene the trailers open with: Lucia, a drink, and the Ocean Beach shoreline. When the early story puts you on Ocean Beach, do not sprint to the next marker; the scene offers the cocktail moment, and taking it is the whole trophy. This guide flags it as missable-risk because the moment belongs to the scripted sequence, not to a bar you can revisit at will.
steps: Play the early story until the Ocean Beach sequence.
When the scene offers a drink, accept and stay for the cocktail moment.
The trophy pops as the moment completes.
tips: If you are already past the opening chapters without it, a fresh save played slowly to the same scene is the fallback - it is only an hour in.
sources: Rockstar Games - Grand Theft Auto VI Trailer 1 (2023), Ocean Beach

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.missableNote: MISSABLE RISK: the showroom escape is a set-piece inside a specific story job. Exiting on foot or by the marked route can complete the mission without the trophy. When the showroom sequence starts, get into a car inside and drive it out through the glass, and keep a save from before the job until it pops.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style - 'classic style' being the series' oldest joke: you do not open the door, you drive a showroom car straight through the plate glass. The chance comes inside a story job set in a dealership. When you find yourself in the showroom with the heat closing in, ignore the pedestrian exit, get behind the wheel of one of the display cars, and put it through the window. The trophy pops as you land on the street outside.
steps: Play the story job that takes you into the vehicle showroom.
When the escape starts, get into a display car inside the showroom.
Drive it out through the glass frontage; the trophy pops on exit.
tips: Aim for the middle of the glass panes at full throttle; clipping a pillar can stop the car dead inside.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The name is the series' oldest running gag - every GTA player has been pestered to go bowling - and the trophy is simple: bowl at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley and follow through, completing the game there. Head to the alley, start a game, and bowl it out to the final frame. A good score is not required; finishing the game at that specific alley is. It also samples the leisure family for Master of None if you have not bowled before.
steps: Travel to the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
Start a bowling game at a lane.
Play all frames to the end; the trophy pops when the game completes.
tips: Do not quit after a few frames - like the arcade trophy, this one pays on completion, not participation.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The official description is deliberately coy - 'A partnership with mass appeal' - and the shape of the list gives it away: this is the third partner trophy, sitting with Hot Together and Retail Therapy. It is earned together with your partner in the game's shared or social play, when the two of you put on the partnership performance the description hints at: take your partner out together in public, in front of an audience, and complete the joint activity the game presents for pairs. Because the exact trigger is a hidden-trophy secret, the practical advice is: during stage 7, do the partner activities together rather than solo - appearances, outings and joint jobs - and it will pop alongside the other two partner trophies.
steps: Be playing with your partner (both protagonists together).
Take part in the joint public or social activities the game offers pairs, together rather than solo.
The trophy pops when the partnership activity completes with an audience present.
tips: If Hot Together and Retail Therapy are done and this has not popped, revisit partner-only markers and social spots together in free roam - it belongs to the same set.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missableNote: MISSABLE RISK: this trophy is built on the story's branching choices, and PlayStation tracks a count behind it (500). A single 'safe' playthrough that always picks the same kind of answer can starve it. Vary your choices, engage with optional decisions and side encounters when they are offered, and keep chapter saves so a skipped choice point can be revisited.
trophies.guide: The description - 'Choices made (for better or worse)' - and the count PlayStation tracks behind it (500) tell the story: this trophy measures the decisions you make across the whole game, in dialogue, in missions and in the world. It is not one big choice but the accumulation of hundreds of small ones. Play actively: answer when the game asks, take sides in encounters, choose routes and outcomes instead of letting timers expire, and the counter climbs through the story. This guide flags it as missable-risk because a passive playthrough that skips optional choices can reach the credits short of the count.
steps: From the opening chapters, engage with every choice the game offers - dialogue picks, mission approaches, world encounters.
Vary your answers rather than defaulting to one style; both 'better' and 'worse' choices count.
Keep making choices through side content after the story; the trophy pops when the tracked count (500) is reached.
tips: Expired timers and walked-away encounters are the silent leak; if a prompt appears, answer it.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list - PSNProfiles (tracked count: 500 choices)

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missableNote: MISSABLE RISK: 'Second time's the charm' means succeeding at something you first failed or refused. A flawless first-try playthrough can walk straight past it. If a story attempt, deal or challenge goes wrong early on, do not reload instantly - play on and succeed at the retry; that fail-then-succeed pair is what this trophy counts.
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm: succeed at an attempt that failed the first time. The game remembers a first failure - a botched job, a refused deal, a lost challenge - and this trophy pays out when you come back and close it out on the retry. The natural way to earn it is simply not to save-scum: when something goes wrong in the story, wear it, then do the thing properly when the chance comes round again. This guide flags it missable-risk for perfectionists: reloading every failure the second it happens can carry you to the credits without ever recording a second attempt.
steps: Let a genuine first attempt fail (a job, challenge or deal) without reloading.
Take the same attempt again when the game offers the retry.
Succeed on the second try; the trophy pops on the successful retry.
tips: Checkpoint restarts inside a mission are not the same thing; the fail-and-retry pair the trophy wants is at the level of a whole attempt.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange. Leonida hides weirdness in its wet corners - lights over the Grassrivers, things moving in the swamp mist, the kind of random event the series has always buried for players who wander. This trophy pops when you are present for one of the game's scripted strange events and watch it play out rather than driving through it. Maximise your chances during stage 3: roam at night, on foot or slowly, in the rural north and the swamps, and when the world does something odd, stop and watch until it finishes.
steps: Roam rural Leonida (Grassrivers, swamps, Mount Kalaga foothills), ideally at night.
When a strange event begins, stay and watch it to its end.
The trophy pops once the event has been witnessed in full.
tips: Fast travel is the enemy of this trophy; the events spawn for travellers, not teleporters.
sources: Rockstar Games - Grand Theft Auto VI Trailer 2 (2025)

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock a pedestrian down with a melee drive-by - swinging a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and connecting. You need a melee weapon equipped, a vehicle you can swing from (a motorcycle is the easiest platform), and a target at the kerb. Ride past at moderate speed and swing as you draw level; too fast and you overshoot the swing window, too slow and it reads as a stop-and-hit. A beachfront path or a boardwalk crowd gives you repeated clean chances until it lands.
steps: Equip a melee weapon and get on a motorcycle (or any vehicle that allows melee swings).
Ride toward a pedestrian at moderate speed.
Swing as you pass so the weapon connects and knocks them down; the trophy pops on the knockdown.
tips: Doing this in a low-wanted area keeps the celebration short; the hit will draw police attention, so be ready to move on.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Robberies and heists pay partly in marked bills - money too hot to spend until a contact washes it for a cut. Every time you come home with marked bills, run them through a laundering contact instead of sitting on them, and the washed total climbs toward the quarter million. The big scores do the heavy lifting: The Cartel Heist and a run of bank vaults (Maximum Withdrawal) feed this trophy faster than street robberies, so stage 6 naturally completes it.
steps: Earn Marked Bills from robberies and heists.
Take them to a laundering contact and wash them for clean cash.
Repeat until $250,000 has been earned through laundering.
tips: Only money actually put through a contact counts; a drawer full of unwashed bills earns nothing.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list - PSNProfiles (tracked count: $250,000)

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops - clothes, weapons, vehicles parts, services, everything counts as long as the money leaves through a till. This is a milestone you should never grind for its own sake: a story playthrough with regular gun-shop and garage visits gets most of the way there, and outfitting both protagonists properly in the endgame closes the rest. If you are short late on, vehicle customisation is the fastest legitimate sink - a full performance and cosmetic build on one car is a five-figure purchase.
steps: Buy normally as you play: weapons, ammo, clothes, vehicle work, services.
Check your spend late in stage 6 if the trophy is still open.
Top up with a vehicle build or property furnishing until $100,000 total is spent.
tips: Money spent by both protagonists counts toward the same total.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list - Exophase (tracked count: $100,000)

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties on the map. Garages come up for sale as you explore - a For Sale sign and a map icon mark each one - and buying is as simple as walking up with the cash. The full set is not cheap, which is why this sits in stage 6 after the heists and laundering have filled your account. Garages also pay you back: stored vehicles are safe, insured parking for the collection Whip It Good has you discovering.
steps: Find a garage property for sale (map icon appears once its area is explored).
Buy it at the sign with either protagonist.
Repeat until all 8 garages are owned.
tips: If a garage icon never appears, its district is probably still unexplored; stage 3's full-map sweep unlocks the stragglers.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list - PSNProfiles (tracked count: 8 garage properties)

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app - the in-game app that logs vehicles to your name. Registering is the formal version of discovering: when you take a vehicle you like, open the app flow and register it, and it is saved as yours. Ten registrations is a small ask next to Whip It Good's 100 discoveries, so pair them: during stage 4's vehicle hunt, register the ten best finds as you go and this trophy will already be done when stage 6 arrives.
steps: Get into a vehicle you want to keep.
Open the Scooter Bros app flow and register the vehicle.
Repeat with new vehicles until 10 are registered.
tips: Register vehicles you actually want stored - registrations double as permanent garage claims.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list - Exophase (tracked count: 10 vehicles)
